exposure: Antenatal tocolytic treatment after preterm prelabor rupture of membranes
outcome: Survival without moderate to severe neurodevelopmental disabilities at 5.5 years of age
cohort: Pregnant individuals with preterm prelabor rupture of membranes at 24 to 32 weeks' gestation in singleton pregnancies with a live fetus, whose infants were born at 24 to 34 weeks' gestation and participated in a 5.5-year assessment.
finding: No association was found between antenatal exposure to tocolytics after preterm prelabor rupture of membranes and survival without moderate to severe neurodevelopmental disabilities or any other neurodevelopmental outcomes at 5.5 years of age.
gest_age: 24 to 34 weeks at birth (with preterm prelabor rupture of membranes occurring at 24-32 weeks)
